rows.text: Based on these assumptions, and inclusive of LIFO expense of $112.5 million, or $1.64 per diluted share, the Company anticipates non‑GAAP earnings per diluted share in the range of $7.40 to $7.60 for the fourth quarter of 2026, up over 200% year‑over‑year.

Second Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights Earnings per share of $6.29 and non‑GAAP earnings per share of $6.27 exceeded the high end of management’s guidance range of $5.15 to $5.35 and were up 42% year-over-year.

Based on these assumptions, and inclusive of LIFO expense of $75.0 million, or $1.10 per diluted share, the Company anticipates non‑GAAP earnings per diluted share in the range of $6.40 to $6.60 for the third quarter of 2026, representing year‑over‑year growth ranging from 76% to 81%.
